options.label: Enabled
options.description:
Double-tap RS in exploration or dialogue-capable story areas to toggle the experimental anchored camera. Double-tap again to return.

Combat/protected states return to the original camera. Normal exploration and non-nested story states are permitted. Detected dialogue/cutscene states and non-gameplay camera modes remain blocked. Story-versus-active-dialogue coverage, eye collision and body visibility still need testing.

options.label: Controller button (double-tap)
options.description: Uses Steam Input's Xbox layout. Single clicks still reach the game. Shared bindings can trigger their normal action.

options.label: Anchor distance calibration (m)
options.description:
Uses a fixed 6-unit reference relative to the player-following anchor, not the retracted third-person camera. More negative moves forward. Your calibrated default is -6.35.

Offset combinations are limited to a 1.25-unit local budget. Invalid settings keep the previous calibration. Eye collision and exact head placement still need testing.

options.label: Camera height offset (m)
options.description: Raises or lowers the close camera. Character visibility is not yet modified.

options.label: Camera side offset (m)
options.description: Adjusts left/right placement. Tune it together with distance. The correct eye position depends on the native camera.

options.label: Fine forward offset (m)
options.description: Positive values move the close camera farther forward. Prototype switches are immediate.

options.label: Keyboard fallback (double-tap)
options.description: Double-tap K by default. Set Unbound to use only the controller.

options.label: Maximum click duration (ms)
options.description: Longer holds do not count as clicks.

options.label: Diagnostic logging
options.description: Adds read-only camera input/output geometry and position-write results, up to twice per second. Use for free-space versus wall-behind-player tests. It does not disable collision or change FOV. State and gesture logs remain available when off.
